messages:
Rina (RevOps): FYI - APAC inbound skew this morning. ~35% of leads hitting 'unassigned'. HubSpot -> SF log shows enrichment sometimes not returning and RR skipping. Anyone able to quick triage?
Diego (Growth): noticed drop in 'first contact' rate. did a quick filter and many leads have no owner tag.
Nikhil (Eng): quick log dump: HS webhook 429/backoffs, enrichment service occasional 6-8s p99. routing treats missing enrichment as noop so lead stays unowned.
Sam (Ops): routing-bot alerted at 07:06: "inbound_unassigned_rate > 0.03 (APAC)" :rotating_light:
Rina (RevOps): propose short-term mitigations: 1) set a fallback_owner after 2.5s TTL, 2) add heartbeat that retries pending leads into RR after 12s, 3) add header X-Enrich-Retry for tracing.
Nikhil (Eng): can do. patch idea: enrichment_timeout_ms=2500, fallback_owner= "inbound-sdr@redwood.com" and tag assignment_reason=fallback_enrich. will also add exponential backoff in webhook client: attempts=5 base=300ms max=4s.
Diego (Growth): fallback owner ok for now. We should tag SF records so reports can exclude or surface them - e.g., Lead.SourceFallback=true.
Sam (Ops): heartbeat sketch: every 15s query leads WHERE state='pending_enrich' AND age_s>12 then POST /routing/rr?prio=low with body {lead_id, probe:true}.
Rina (RevOps): metrics to add: fallback_assign_rate, fallback_to_reassign_pct (24h), enrichment_p99_by_region. Alert rule: fallback_assign_rate > 2% for >15m -> notify revops+oncall.
Nikhil (Eng): I'll open a small PR with unit tests and a canary flag: routing.fallback.enabled=true. plan: canary 8% traffic for 90m, run synthetic slow events, then promote if fallback_assign_rate stays <1%.
Diego (Growth): I'll prepare a short banner for SDRs and a playbook snippet: "Fallback assignments are temporary; please verify contact and reassign if needed."
routing-bot: Incident created: "APAC enrichment timeouts - fallback enabled" id: INC-357951. :white_check_mark:
Rina (RevOps): post-deploy checklist: sample 100 fallback leads, check SF owner mapping integrity, measure 24h reassignment rate and any drop in lead conversion. Tag updates here when PR/monitoring links ready. Thanks team.
